transcript_only_text:
Some things that you can do to
immediately make more money. Let's say we'll take this book. I could raise the
price of my book. Number two is that you can decrease cost. I could buy in larger
economies of scale to decrease the cost of the book or I could figure out what I
could do from a shipping perspective to negotiate better rates on my shipping.
Number three is that you can have upsells. Instead of being a digital
book, I could upsell a hard version of this book. The downsell here is the
reverse of the upsell. If people can't afford my hardback, then I say why don't
you have one of my digital copies, which is cheaper. You can also have
cross-sells. I would sell a second book that was different than the original
book. You can add in financing so that people could pay for this book up front.
You can change the terms of how you collect payment. You know what? You can
have a payment plan and you can pay as long as you want, but we don't start
working until you pay off everything. You can absolutely do this with any
business. It's actually harder with physical products than it is with
services.
